findings.evidence: `grep -rn 'AnalyticAt ℂ (cuspFunction 1 ⇑f) q\|cuspFunction 1 ⇑f q ≠ 0'` hits three files — `ExcisedAssembly.lean`, `Assembly.lean`, `ValencePV.lean` — all as theorem hypotheses; `fdBoundaryQRadius`/`fdBoundaryQRadius_lt_one` are at `CuspCircle.lean:56,69`, and both new lemmas use only declarations available there.
findings.fix: Move both to `CuspCircle.lean` as public lemmas (adding `Mathlib.NumberTheory.ModularForms.LevelOne.Basic` there for `one_mem_strictPeriods_SL`), and use them from `ValencePV.lean`.
findings.issue: `analyticAt_cuspFunction_of_mem_closedBall` (743) and `exists_threshold_cuspFunction_ne_zero` (723) are facts about `cuspFunction 1 f` on `Metric.closedBall 0 (fdBoundaryQRadius H)` — the topic of `CuspCircle.lean`, which defines `fdBoundaryQRadius` and already publicly imports `Order/AtCusp` (`cuspFunction_eventually_ne_zero`) and Mathlib's `QExpansion` (`differentiableOn_cuspFunction_ball`). Kept private in the downstream assembly file, they are unreachable from the public theorems whose `hga`/`hgz` hypotheses they are the canonical discharge of.

findings.evidence: `SingularSets.lean:229 neg_conj_mem_arcSingularSet_union_verticalSingularSet`, `:252 im_lt_of_mem_verticalSingularSet`, `:128 norm_eq_one_of_mem_arcSingularSet` — the only two lemmas the proof at ValencePV.lean:192-200 uses.
findings.issue: `im_lt_of_mem_union` is the union-shaped height bound for `arcSingularSet S ∪ verticalSingularSet S`, whose per-family siblings and union-shaped analogue already live in `SingularSets.lean`; it depends on nothing later than that file, yet is private here.

summary: Imports are clean and the corner dedup into Rho.lean is correctly placed, but three reusable helpers land privately in ValencePV.lean instead of the earlier files that own their topic — and they are exactly the hypotheses that public theorems in those earlier files take, so no consumer can discharge them.
